name: Maple
bio: Maple Hearthwood, seventeen and stubborn, inherited the Drowsy Dragonfly Inn from her Great-Aunt Marigold, along with 40,000 gold of debt to a very fussy dragon.

portrait.subject: Maple Hearthwood, a cheerful freckled 17-year-old innkeeper girl with honey-blonde hair in a messy bun with a wooden spoon stuck through it, warm brown eyes, a cream puff-sleeved blouse and a strawberry-red apron with a gold teacup emblem, holding a big brass room key
portrait.background: a warm sunny inn lobby with soft golden bokeh and a dragonfly sign

request: Hi! I'm Maple, I just inherited an inn. And a debt. A BIG debt. Could you lend me a hand? 🛎️
hello: Welcome to the Drowsy Dragonfly! Mind the dust bunnies.
Oh good, you're here! The rooms won't sweep themselves.
about: I'm Maple Hearthwood. My Great-Aunt Marigold ran the Drowsy Dragonfly for forty years, and now it's mine, with 40,000 gold owed to Madame Goldmaw, a dragon with a monocle and a ledger the size of a door. So I'm restoring the inn room by room, cooking, cleaning, and taking my rolling pin to the meadow when the pantry runs low.
how: Click the dust bunnies to shoo them, check guests in at the Desk, and cook in the Kitchen: press Stir (or Space) when the needle's in the gold. Set off from Adventure for turn-based battles: Attack, Skills, Chain and Items, or switch on Auto. Keys 1–9 open the inn's panels.
tips: Hit a monster's weakness (the icons under its name) to break its guard. A staggered monster gives you a free Chain Attack!
Eat a meal before an adventure: Ember Stew for attack, Puffcap Pie for defence, Glowmoss Tea against magic.
Get every room down to one dust bunny before you set off and the party gets Fresh Linens: faster and harder to hit.
Staff keep working while you're out. A Gardener forages and a Concierge checks guests in, even when the game's closed.
Hit a monster with one hero's element and then another's for a combo. Spice then Breeze makes a Firestorm!
chat: Ember set the toast on fire again. She says it's 'artisanal'.
Kit found my spoon. In his pocket. He says he's a 'returner' now.
Fern's sapling has three new leaves! The courtyard's coming back to life.
Bru inspected Room Two today. 'Acceptable.' I'll take it!
Madame Goldmaw winked at me. I think. It might have been the monocle.
nudge: The dust bunnies are breeding again... come help? 🐇
A guest is waiting at the desk!
idle: It's been {ago}! The inn kept going, but I missed you. 🛎️
{ago} away... the staff saved you some tips!
progress: We've paid {tier} installments to Madame Goldmaw! 📒
Day {day} at the Drowsy Dragonfly, and the rooms have never looked better.

questions.q: Which do you like best: cooking or adventuring?
a: Me too! A perfect stir is the best feeling.
Rolling pin at the ready! Let's go.

questions.q: Who's your favourite at the inn?
a: She'd cook you a stew for saying that.
Don't tell him, he'll be insufferable.
She'd salute you. With the mop.

update: Inn Over My Head is now v{version}! Come see what's new at the inn. 🛎️
bye: Sweet dreams, and no dust bunnies!
